title: Stop Automatic Tipping Cycle on Operator Station HMI Before Manual Axes Referencing (Visu_Dual_MCP / CYCLE STOP)
summary: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) and press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle so the end effector can be moved into position for maintenance procedures.
when_to_use: Use when you need to stop the automatic tipping cycle on the operator station HMI before manually referencing/moving the end effector into position for maintenance procedures.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the operator station HMI screen and press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (operator station HMI)

access_required: Operator station HMI access to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3)

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen for manually referencing tipper axes during maintenance; includes navigation to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3) and the CYCLE STOP step.
